card.name: Just before edema and fluid-retention terms
card.fires_on: Commas and small linking words right before an expected edema or fluid-retention term, such as after "weight gain" in heart-failure warnings. Also seen in dosing text for edema treatment.

modes.label: After weight gain
modes.description: A comma after "weight gain" in a list of fluid-retention signs, where edema or swelling comes next.

modes.label: Linking word before edema

modes.example: reports of new onset or worsening<< of>> edema have been received.
